title: Transport a diagonal diagram along normalized scalar comparisons
statement: For a coefficient-ring map a, a diagonal Diagram d, normalized scalar endpoints on the lines at P and W, and full-unit-normalized restriction squares to the canonical target right-derived models [lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived] whose scalar mates on the shifted lines are invertible, there exists a target Diagram with ScalarCompatibility for a and the specified line maps. The schemes P and W are Noetherian. This is the categorical assembly: regular endpoints, supported-source normalization, conjugation of the class and traces, and transport of the integration identities. It assumes the geometric line and direct-image comparisons, not the existence of a target Diagram.

source.place: paragraphs (1)--(2), transporting one fixed diagram through a coefficient change

proof.text: Construct the regular scalar endpoint for every scheme using the unique ordinary multiplication comparison and the flat single-complex scalar endpoint theorem. The coefficient unit normalization is preserved when transporting the endpoint along the multiplication isomorphism.

Apply supported-source scalar compatibility to both projections. The resulting supported endpoint homs agree: apply injectivity of the scalar adjunction hom-equivalence, rewrite both normalizations, and use faithfulness of the underlying module forgetful functor. Rewrite the second source equation with the first endpoint.

Use the given line endpoints and scalar squares with the canonical target models. Define the target class by inverse supported endpoint, scalar image of the class, and shifted line endpoint. Define each target trace by the inverse of the composite of the scalar/direct-image mate with direct image of the shifted line endpoint, followed by the scalar image of the trace and the regular endpoint. Inverse cancellation proves the class and trace squares. Apply integration_transport twice with the normalized source equations. The canonical models have functor and full-unit normalizations by definition. Assemble Diagram and ScalarCompatibility.

theorem diagonal_scalar_diagram_of_squares
    {Λ Λ' : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj Λ'] [IsCommMonObj Λ']
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ X) (L' : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ' X)
    (m : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, (L X).X ⟶ (L' X).X) (d : Diagram Λ Y L)
    (lineP : Endpoint a (L (ProjectiveLine Y)) (L' (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (m (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (lineW : Endpoint a (L (diagonalSurface Y)) (L' (diagonalSurface Y))
      (m (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (q : RestrictionSquare a (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) d.Rq
      (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived
        (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ' (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))))
    (p₁ : RestrictionSquare a
      (pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) d.R₁
      (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ'
        (pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))))
    (p₂ : RestrictionSquare a
      (pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) d.R₂
      (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ'
        (pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))))
    (hq : IsIso ((q.mate a).app
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (L (ProjectiveLine Y)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))
    (h₁ : IsIso ((p₁.mate a).app
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))
    (h₂ : IsIso ((p₂.mate a).app
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))) :
    ∃ d' : Diagram Λ' Y L', Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility a Y L L' m d d')
